Name: Forever Falls Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Farm Map is 200 Tiles Tall and 155 Wide, Which is about 6x the size of a normal farm, or about the same as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9347]Everfarm[/url].
Then there are the submaps.

This Map is Designed as another Omni Map, Inspired in part by a user's comment and the fact we now have 2 tall cliffs with 1.6 that I can play with.

This map introduces a new farm types, it is not a replacer.

It does not touch anything outside the farm so it should be compatible with most mods..

Features of this map include.
~ Farm Wand (Takes you to Warp Map, Arrives in Mail on your 2nd day.)
~ Tillable Grass on All Maps.
~ Destroyable Berry Bushes so you can clear them for space.

~~ The Main Surface Farm contains.
~ A Massive Amount of Space
~ 2 Quarries
~ Forest/Lake Fish ﻿ ﻿(The Rivers)
~ Lake Fish ﻿ ﻿(The Lake with islands)
~ Ocean Fish ﻿ ﻿(The Ocean Area)
~ Both Types of Crab Pots ﻿ ﻿(Ocean in Ocean Area, the Rest is Freshwater)
~ Beach Crates
~ Beach Forage
~ Seed Weeds
~ Forest Forage
~ Respawning Stumps and Logs Along the Easter Forest Border.
~ Berry Bushes
~ Blue Grass
﻿ ﻿Note! Beach Tiles do not allow sprinklers!

Submaps!

~~ Foraging Area
~ Respawning Stumps
~ Higher Density Forest Forage
~ High Density Seed Weeds
~ Berry Bushes
~ Able to build Buildings Here

~~ Cavern
~ Is Entirely a Greenhouse Area
~ High Density Seed Weeds
~ Quarries
~ Custom Forage Spawns (All Mushrooms, Cave Carrots and Fiddlehead Fern)
~ River Fish
~ Able to build Buildings Here
~ Allows Grass Survival and Growth in Winter.

~~ Spa
~ Is Entirely a Greenhouse Area
~ Contains a Spa to regain energy
~ Allows Grass Survival and Growth in Winter.

~~ Fruit Bat Cave
~ Is Entirely a Greenhouse Area
~ Random Fruit will spawn here Every Day.
~ Able to build Buildings Here
~ Allows Grass Survival and Growth in Winter.

~~ Upper Mine
~ Allows Transit from the Top of the cliff down to the Lower Mine on the Beach.
~ Contains water, as the top of the cliff has none.

~~ Lower Mine
~ Has a Great Amount of Ore Spawns.
~ Allows Grass Survival in Winter.
﻿ ﻿Note! Diggable Tiles do not allow sprinklers!

~~ Quarry
~ Has a Great Amount of Ore Spawns.
~ Allows Grass Survival in Winter.
﻿ ﻿Note! Diggable Tiles do not allow sprinklers!

~~Beach Cave
~ Contains Higher Density Beach Forage
~ Contains Higher Density Beach Crates
~ Ocean Fish and Crab Pots.
﻿ ﻿Note! Diggable Tiles do not allow sprinklers!

Manifest.Name: Forever Falls Farm CP
Manifest.Description: A Huge Mountain Farm that slopes down erratically, eventually leading into a lake then beach. The farm has warps to help you get around, Quarries, Beach Crates and Forage, All types of Fish, Blue Grass, Forest Forage, and Mixed Seed Weeds. It also has a Large Cavern(With Mushroom & Fern Forrage), a Forest Forage Area, a Spa, and a Fruit Bat cave that generates fruit..
Manifest.Author: Draylon
